part.text: The crash file has yearly motorist-fatality counts, but no vehicle-miles-traveled or other mileage exposure measure, so it cannot directly establish risk per mile. I’m preparing two useful alternatives: annual motorist deaths and motorist deaths per 100,000 reported crashes, with the latter clearly treated as a crash-normalized measure rather than a per-mile risk.

input.patchText:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: out/_generate.py
+import duckdb
+import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
+import pandas as pd
+
+
+DATA = "data/crashes.parquet"
+OUT = "out"
+
+df = duckdb.sql(
+    f"""
+    SELECT
+      EXTRACT(YEAR FROM crash_date)::INTEGER AS year,
+      COUNT(*)::INTEGER AS reported_crashes,
+      SUM(COALESCE(number_of_motorist_killed, 0))::INTEGER AS motorist_deaths
+    FROM read_parquet('{DATA}')
+    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM crash_date) BETWEEN 2013 AND 2025
+    GROUP BY year
+    ORDER BY year
+    """
+).df()
+df["motorist_deaths_per_100k_crashes"] = (
+    df["motorist_deaths"] / df["reported_crashes"] * 100_000
+)
+
+# Option 1: absolute annual number of motorist deaths.
+values1 = df[["year", "motorist_deaths"]]
+values1.to_csv(f"{OUT}/values_1.csv", index=False)
+fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 5.5))
+ax.plot(values1["year"], values1["motorist_deaths"], marker="o", color="#176B87", linewidth=2.5)
+ax.set(title="Motorists killed in NYC crashes, 2013–2025", xlabel="Year", ylabel="Motorists killed (people)")
+ax.set_xticks(values1["year"])
+ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.25)
+ax.annotate("2013: 110", (2013, 110), xytext=(8, 10), textcoords="offset points")
+ax.annotate("2025: 81", (2025, 81), xytext=(-48, 10), textcoords="offset points")
+fig.text(0.01, 0.01, "Fatality counts are not adjusted for miles driven; this chart does not measure risk per mile.", fontsize=9)
+fig.tight_layout(rect=(0, 0.05, 1, 1))
+fig.savefig(f"{OUT}/option_1.png", dpi=180, bbox_inches="tight")
+plt.close(fig)
+
+# Option 2: annual motorist deaths divided by all reported crash records.
+values2 = df[["year", "reported_crashes", "motorist_deaths", "motorist_deaths_per_100k_crashes"]]
+values2.to_csv(f"{OUT}/values_2.csv", index=False, float_format="%.6f")
+fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 5.5))
+ax.plot(values2["year"], values2["motorist_deaths_per_100k_crashes"], marker="o", color="#A64B36", linewidth=2.5)
+ax.set(title="Motorist deaths per 100,000 reported crashes, 2013–2025", xlabel="Year", ylabel="Deaths per 100,000 crash reports")
+ax.set_xticks(values2["year"])
+ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.25)
+first = values2.iloc[0]
+last = values2.iloc[-1]
+ax.annotate(f"2013: {first.motorist_deaths_per_100k_crashes:.1f}", (first.year, first.motorist_deaths_per_100k_crashes), xytext=(8, 10), textcoords="offset points")
+ax.annotate(f"2025: {last.motorist_deaths_per_100k_crashes:.1f}", (last.year, last.motorist_deaths_per_100k_crashes), xytext=(-55, 10), textcoords="offset points")
+fig.text(0.01, 0.01, "Crash-report denominator is not miles driven; this chart does not measure risk per mile.", fontsize=9)
+fig.tight_layout(rect=(0, 0.05, 1, 1))
+fig.savefig(f"{OUT}/option_2.png", dpi=180, bbox_inches="tight")
+plt.close(fig)
+
+print(df.to_string(index=False))
*** End Patch
